tutorial_text.text:
PLAYER SPECIALS

"Special Attacks" are performed with the "$specialBind" input.

Player characters may have a maneuver bound to the "special input" as an extra tool.

Meanwhile, enemy specials often pose a unique mechanic to work around.



ENEMY SPECIALS

The Shrub uses a bash as his special attack, which inflicts a stun that prevents defense.

Effectively, the bash guarantees an attack on top of extra stamina damage.

Pressing the "Down Guard" key dodges this attack.



PLAYER SPECIALS

Player specials range in their utility and purpose.



It can be a core part of a character's offense or defense.

The Shrub's bash is one such, having a multitude of effects detailed in the "Bash" tutorial.



In other cases it may simply be a helpful, but optional tool.

Boyfriend's "Pose" special trades some combat health for stamina.

Very helpful for keeping up aggression, but ultimately isn't required to win a fight.
